agents.drug_class_hint: phytopharmaceutical (sodium copper chlorophyllin), antioxidant/radioprotective, given for radionecrosis

coder_notes: Chlorophyllin is given to treat brain radionecrosis (a late radiotherapy effect), not as an antitumour agent; the record's anti-cancer wording is background only and PFS/OS are routine secondary outcomes. Stratum A arm text mentions a combination of steroids and CHL, but steroids are not a registered intervention.
